ai_note: No disclosed AI revenue or AI-disruption exposure; management cites internal 'AI transformation' only as an operating-efficiency initiative, not a growth or risk driver
why: China's largest securities broker, riding a 2025-2026 A-share/H-share trading-volume and market-rally boom (H1 FY2026 revenue +44% YoY, net profit +69.6% YoY) plus a regulatory tailwind pushing consolidation toward a handful of 'national champion' brokers; the DCF's own base case labels FY2026 'the cycle peak' with FY2027-28 giving back ~11% of revenue as turnover and investment-income marks normalize.
watch: China A-share/H-share average daily trading turnover -- the FY2025 surge (+69.77% YoY) is the explicit driver of the brokerage/investment-income jump; a turnover slowdown ends the acceleration quickly

Mark-to-market swings in the RMB770bn+ FVTPL proprietary trading book (36.9% of FY2025 revenue, the single largest and most volatile line) -- large gains in an up market are symmetric with large losses in a down one
Gearing ratio (79.16% in 2025, up from 74.5% in 2022) and repo/short-term-financing reliance -- rising leverage funding the balance sheet in a boom is a classic late-cycle signal

Price versus the $15.05 base-case entry price (DCF weighted entry $15.17); current price HK$21.24 is already above both the base and bull-case entry points, and the bear scenario (policy tightening or a market reversal) prices the stock near HK$9.63-10
next_catalyst: FY2026 annual report, expected March 2027 (per FY2025 annual report release pattern)
exclude_reason: Growth is a China equity-market-turnover and trading cycle (classic brokerage cyclical), explicitly flagged by the DCF base case as peaking in FY2026 and reversing in FY2027-28 -- not a durable, structural acceleration.
